name: xxe-external-entities-explicitly-enabled
attack_scenario: Attacker uploads XML with <!DOCTYPE x [<!ENTITY e SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]>&e;; the re-enabled entity-expanding parser reads local files or performs SSRF to internal endpoints, and billion-laughs entities can DoS the service.
negative_test_hint: submit XML containing "<!DOCTYPE x [<!ENTITY e SYSTEM 'file:///etc/passwd'>]>" and assert the parser rejects the DOCTYPE or resolves no external entity content

exemplar.explanation: Explicitly re-enabling entity expansion (setExpandEntityReferences(true), libxml_disable_entity_loader(false), resolveExternals/substituteEntities=true, external-general-entities=true, XmlResolver = new XmlUrlResolver, DtdProcessing.Parse, LIBXML_NOENT) turns a parser a framework had defaulted to safe back into an XXE vector, enabling local-file read, SSRF, and billion-laughs DoS. The hardened inverse (expansion disabled, DTDs prohibited, resolver null) keeps attacker-supplied XML inert.
